thread:
sara: Quick FYI — planning a phased enable for ff.model_v7_unveil starting in 30m. Target audiences: internal beta + a small regional slice. :eyes:
kevin: ack. can you post the exact %s and regions?
anika: what are the abort conditions? we should gate on both error rate and tail latency.
sara: plan below:
- step 0: enable 5% in eu-west (internal + beta customers)
- step 1: enable 2% in us-west (internal only)
- step 2: expand by +5% every 45m if health metrics OK
Abort/rollback triggers:
- error rate (5xx or model failures) > 1.5% for 15m window
- p95 latency > 800ms for 10m window
- quality regressions: semantic-score-drop > 3 points on eval prompt set (automated)
kevin: who will press the expand button? is this automatic or manual?
sara: rollout controller will auto-increment but only if all health checks pass. manual hold via flag path if someone wants to pause: `/flags/ff.model_v7_unveil/hold`
anika: add a guard to never exceed 30% in any single region without PM signoff.
sara: agreed — hard cap at 30% per region in config. also will add a strict ramp rate to avoid sudden load spikes.
sre_oncall: put the SLOs and thresholds into the incident bot so it alerts early. want noisy alerts at first.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by sara at 2026-04-02T14:00:00Z — job id rdu-rollout-775. No downtime expected.
kevin: quick check on rollout CLI so I can replicate locally?
sara: use this snippet for manual ops:
```
# set initial percentages
rolloutctl set ff.model_v7_unveil --region eu-west --percent 5
rolloutctl set ff.model_v7_unveil --region us-west --percent 2
# watch health
rolloutctl watch rdu-rollout-775 --metrics p95.latency,error_rate,semantic_score
```
anika: will you attach the eval prompt set? want a few targeted cases for hallucination/regression monitoring.
sara: attaching short list in the QA doc, also wired into the quality monitor. if semantic_score drops >3 points, controller will revert to previous model variant.
kevin: tagging @anika for review on the abort thresholds. I skimmed — looks conservative which is good. :thumbsup:
anika: thumbs up. please set notification channel to #eng-runtime-alerts and add me to on-call notifications for the next 6 hours.
sara: done. alerts: #eng-runtime-alerts, +anika, +sre_oncall. I'll post a short status update after step 1 completes.
sre_oncall: I'll keep an eye on infra metrics (GPU queueing, OOMs). if queue depth > 1.5x baseline for 10m, I'll trigger a manual pause.
sara: perfect. if anyone needs to force-disable immediately, command is:
```
rolloutctl disable ff.model_v7_unveil --reason "emergency rollback" --force
```
kevin: thanks — will standby during the ramp. :rocket:
sara: thanks all — will post back after the 5% eu-west enable.
